title: 航空緊急疏散系統
summary: 以「以出口可用性、排隊及理解時間研究疏散系統」為主線，在桌上虛擬人流與出口資訊模型中依序完成通道流率與理想時間下限、出口標示的角解析度、緊急照明的電力需求、共用電源造成的出口資訊依賴、參與者與情境代表性及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Study evacuation through exit availability, queueing and comprehension time in a Tabletop virtual flow and exit-information model, progressing through Passage flow and ideal time lower bound, Angular resolution of exit signs, Emergency-lighting power demand, Exit-information dependence on common power, Participant and scenario representativeness, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 通道流率與理想時間下限：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Passage flow and ideal time lower bound: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 通道流率與理想時間下限 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Passage flow and ideal time lower bound and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「航空緊急疏散系統」中，本單元處理「通道流率與理想時間下限」。人數除有效總流率給理想排隊時間，需另加反應、走行和出口可用性變化。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft emergency evacuation systems, this unit examines Passage flow and ideal time lower bound. Population divided by effective total flow gives ideal queue time; reaction, travel and exit availability add separately.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：假想人數N=60、兩通道各q=0.8 person/s。關係式 t=N/(2q)；含輸出單位換算的算式 60/(2*0.8)，結果 37.5 s。適用範圍：理想均勻分流，不是飛機疏散認證測試或承諾完成時間。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Hypothetical population N=60 and two passages each q=0.8 person/s. Relation t=N/(2q); evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 60/(2*0.8) gives 37.5 s. Applicability: Ideal balanced flow, not an aircraft evacuation-certification test or promised completion time.
steps.failure: 在「通道流率與理想時間下限」的情境中，人員集中於熟悉出口使總理論流率無法達成。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Passage flow and ideal time lower bound, Preference for familiar exits can prevent the theoretical total flow from being realized.
steps.check: 針對「通道流率與理想時間下限」，用桌上人流模型加入反應差、阻塞和通道失效，與理想下限比較。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Passage flow and ideal time lower bound, Add reaction spread, blockage and exit loss to a tabletop flow model and compare with the ideal lower bound. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「航空緊急疏散系統」的「通道流率與理想時間下限：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「座艙模擬器：回應之前」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Passage flow and ideal time lower bound: Mechanism and observation” in “Aircraft emergency evacuation systems”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Cockpit Simulator: Before the Response” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
